ridership.units: recorded rail boarding/alighting events; not unique people or simultaneous occupants
ridership.scope: 257 station general rail data; exclude metropolitan electric rail and ITX-Cheongchun per source scope

goals.concurrent_population: derive from event flow, train waves and explicit dwell/companion/staff assumptions; NPC32 target withdrawn

synthetic_stress_claim: algorithm/resource tests only; never actual Busan simultaneous crowd occupancy
arrival_and_departure_contract: clock schedules intents; physical entry/exit and movement completion require qualified observations; never erase distant individuals or teleport completion
LOD_contract: detail selection is separate from persistent identity/state/seed/goal graph; every individual remains model input; distant dynamics/render implementation remains unverified

rate_units.PASSENGER_PERSON_EVENTS_PER_HOUR: rail passengers only; party Poisson rate divides this by E[passenger party size]
rate_units.VISITOR_PERSONS_PER_HOUR: visitor members only; excludes rail passenger data unless independently observed
rate_units.STAFF_PERSONS_PER_HOUR: staff members only; never included in rail ridership
rate_units.PARTY_ARRIVALS_PER_HOUR: explicit group-arrival input; never directly substituted for recorded passenger persons rate

companion_contract: Non-passenger companions are additional explicitly declared flow assumptions, counted separately from every rail passenger member.
